primary.title: Death certificate in India: How to register, documents required and what changes for delayed registration from 1 Oct
primary.summary: A death certificate is essential for settling insurance, mutual funds, investments, property and tax matters after a death. Here is how to register a death in India, documents required, where to apply and what delayed registration rules currently apply.
